mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5, 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances, or Rank IC over 3-year window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1700) and retail sales (RSAFS < 600,000) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >45% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sharp industrial production decline (INDPRO < 95) indicates supply chain disruption, compressing corporate margins and increasing inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95, 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances, or Rank IC for INDPRO predicting 60-day returns <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized) signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 predicting 60-day returns <0.03 in any 3-year window, or average 60-day returns during GDPC1 >2.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL > 3.5) indicates accelerating price pressures, prompting imminent Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.5, 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year window <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in payroll growth (PAYEMS < 100k) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0) signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 5-day returns in >45% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing market contraction (HOUST < 1700) during housing downturn regimes reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as demand weakens.
failure_condition: During housing downturns (HOUST < 1700), 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances, or Rank IC for HOUST predicting 20-day returns in this regime <0.03.
